snippet.title: Human.EXE - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Human.EXE is our upcoming Psychological Horror game about answering a series of moral and ethical questions for a questing AI that is aiming to take over the world.

The Future of Humanity is in YOUR hands. Trolley Problems and Ethical Questions to determine our future.

An AI has isolated the mind of a philosophy professor to evaluate human morality and gain absolute autonomy. As the terminal operator, access files, run programs and take his consciousness through ethical dilemmas: torture, human cloning, mortality. Every answer will be analyzed. Your decisions will train the AI's final algorithm.
